summary: Registration form — Registration Number field format validation
description: Registration Number is a required field. It must follow the format [A-Z]{1,2}-[0-9]{3,5} and be validated before the form can be submitted.

acs.text: Registration Number field accepts values matching the pattern [A-Z]{1,2}-[0-9]{3,5}
Registration Number field rejects values not matching the pattern with an inline error: 'Invalid format. Use 1-2 capital letters, a dash, then 3-5 digits (e.g. AB-12345)'
Form submit button is disabled if Registration Number is empty or currently showing a validation error
